# contato<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Imperium · Cartão digital</title>
<meta name="description" content="Imperium Construções LTDA – construções em geral, reformas e pinturas, limpeza de terrenos e projeções 3D. WhatsApp (47) 99264-0102.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Saira:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* VOICE: sóbrio, forte, de obra
   IDEA: os stories da Imperium virando um cartão de bolso
   PICTURE: o elmo e o arco do logo sobre o grafite liso
   COLOUR and TYPE: grafite #322F2D, branco, cinza quente; Saira
   LAYOUT: coluna única de celular, botões grandes de contato */
:root{--bg:#322F2D;--ink:#FFFFFF;--muted:#B9B4AF;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.22);--card:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0}
body{margin:0;background:#262422;color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 Saira,system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:100vh;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.wrap{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:440px;min-height:100vh;background:var(--bg);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
header{padding:56px 24px 8px;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.logo{width:min(250px,64vw);height:auto}
h1{margin:40px 24px 0;text-align:center;font-weight:400;font-size:26px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:1.5px}
nav{padding:24px 20px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
nav a{min-height:60px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 20px;font-weight:500;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.5px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .15s,background .15s}
nav a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}nav a:active{transform:scale(.98)}
nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}
nav a.main{background:#FFFFFF;border-color:#FFFFFF;color:#322F2D;font-weight:600}
nav a span{flex:1;white-space:nowrap}nav a small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}nav a.main small{color:#5E5853}
nav svg{flex:none}
section{padding:40px 20px 0}
h2{margin:0 0 14px;text-align:center;font-weight:500;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
li{background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.25}
li svg{width:24px;height:24px}
footer{margin-top:auto;padding:56px 20px 28px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
</style>
</head>
